text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for troubling you.
That was careless of me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Still, something of this level is merely tripping a little against a hostile wind."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us return to training
without delay.
choice_data_list: Let's do what we can within our limits.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: However, if it's truly only to this extent, it's nothing to worry about, but...
choice_data_list: You have to be prepared for anything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Indeed, gusts of wind do blow suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't underestimate nature or injuries. Let's play it safe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr gave her nod of agreement, albeit somewhat reluctantly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's head back to the track.
If it's light training as gentle as a breeze—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: Even a little training looks like it'd be tough on you.
Even a little training looks like it'd be tough on you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...It seems so. If I push myself too far here, I won't even be able to stir up a gentle breeze..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Much as it goes against my wishes, I shall spend today resting quietly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr reluctantly gave up on training for the day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us return to training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It's only a gentle breeze,
but the wind truly is wonderful, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Yamanin Zephyr carried out her training
within a reasonable, manageable pace.
